t.en: you will be able to do justice
And (prohibited are) the ones who are married
and set forth to them / strike them
(even as much as) a hair on a date-seed
(even as much as the) speck on a date seed

t.id: dan Kami telah memberikan kepada mereka
dan pasti Kami beri petunjuk mereka
t.en: And We would have guided them
(even as much as) a hair on a date-seed
surely He (would have) given them power
and surely they (would have) fought you

t.id: dan sungguh saya akan menyesatkan mereka
t.en: And I will surely mislead them

t.id: dan sungguh saya akan membangkitkan angan-angan kosong mereka
t.en: and surely arouse desires in them

t.id: dan sungguh saya akan menyuruh mereka
t.en: and surely I will order them
so they will surely cut off

t.id: dan sungguh saya akan menyuruh mereka
t.en: and surely I will order them

t.id: dan memberikan angan-angan kosong kepada mereka

t.en: (even as much as) the speck on a date-seed
and the ones who are weak
the ones who are near (to Allah)
then He will give them in full

t.id: dan Dia/Allah akan memberi petunjuk pada mereka
